object: rock graffito on a fallen block, over a rude figure of a man on a horse, camel or other animal
site: Dakka: isolated table-shaped hill south of Gebel Abu Dirwa, three miles south-west of the temple (Lower Nubia), south side of the hill
notes: Rock graffito in archaic style, one of three found by O. Bates (Archaeological Survey of Nubia, Bulletin 5); Griffith's hand-copies of November 1910 and Firth's photographs (Pls. XI, XII). The letter in rem is Griffith's sub-number (91 a, b, c); REM's own form of the suffix was not checked. Griffith: 'doubtless a proper name, Yilin, with the common termination qo'; the n-sign is 10 cm high. The type is letter-spaced, so the word division follows Griffith's analysis (name + qo).
